Enjoy exceptional resort-style amenities including an indoor lap pool, sauna, steam room, hot tub, fitness centre, squash court, theatre, guest suite, concierge service and more. Ideally located just steps from the Seawall, George Wainborn Park, David Lam Park, Urban Fare and Yaletown’s finest restaurants, with shopping, cafés and entertainment right at your doorstep. One secure parking stall included.
